<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,801)><$facial(4,14)><$kfacial(4)><$comeff(4,9)>I feel like there’s even more <$cdef(27)>humidity than before... It’s
really making me want to...to...

<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,801)><$facial(4,14)><$kfacial(4)><$comeff(4,9)>Eu sinto que há ainda mais <$cdef(27)>humidade do que antes... É
realmente fazendo-me querer...

dialogues.pt_br: <$textsize(2)>*YAAAAAAWWWWWWWWWWWWW</textsize>

<$facial(4,1)><$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,5)>Th-that yawn just now... It was perfect! A <$cdef(27)>full
100-point yawn!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(4,1)><$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,5)>Aquele bocejo foi perfeito! <$cdef(27)>cheio
Bocejo de 100 pontos!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,10)>Yaaay! It’s raining!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,10)>Yaaay! Está chovendo!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(3,8)><$voicel(3,10)>Oooh, that feels so nice! ♪
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(3,8)><$voicel(3,10)>Oh, isso é tão bom!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(5,2)><$voicel(5,10)>Whoa, awesome! It actually worked!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(5,2)><$voicel(5,10)>Fantástico, funcionou mesmo!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,659)>Hohoho! See, it’s just as I told you.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,661)>Now it should be easier to break the walls trapping <$cdef(27)>Onix in
that ca—
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,659)>Hohoho! Veja, é exatamente como eu lhe disse.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,661)>Agora deve ser mais fácil quebrar as paredes aprisionando <$cdef(27)>Onix em
Que ca...

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,6)>Hm?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,6)>Hm?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(5,4)><$motion(5,805)><$comeff(5,6)>Uh...who turned off the rain?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(5,4)><$motion(5,805)><$comeff(5,6)>Quem desligou a chuva?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>Oh dear... I really doubt that was enough rain to help...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>Meu Deus... duvido que tenha sido chuva suficiente para ajudar...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,6)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke</color>, can you yawn again?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,6)>Olá. <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke</color>pode bocejar outra vez?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,14)>Sure, of course...<wait(1.3)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,14)><$se2d(979)> *yawn*
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,14)>Claro, claro...<wait(1.3)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,14)><$se2d(979)> *Aurora*

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,3)>...<$cdef(27)>2 points</color>.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,3)>...<$cdef(27)>2 pontos</color>.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,39)>The rain made me so happy that it kinda woke me right up!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,39)>A chuva fez-me tão feliz que me acordou logo!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(3,3)><$motion(3,807)><$facial(3,9)><$comeff(3,10)>Awww... But we all worked so hard!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(3,3)><$motion(3,807)><$facial(3,9)><$comeff(3,10)>Awww... Mas todos trabalhávamos tanto!

dialogues.en: <$textsize(2)>Gyararoooah!</textsize>
dialogues.pt_br: <$textsize(2)>Gyararoooah!</textsize>

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,4)>Wh-what was that?!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>It sounded like it was coming from the ocean! Let’s all
go see!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,4)>O que foi isso?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Parecia que estava vindo do oceano! Vamos todos
Vai ver!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,8)><$motion(4,803)><$comeff(4,10)>Whoa... They’re huge...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(4,8)><$motion(4,803)><$comeff(4,10)>Whoa... Eles são enormes...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>C-could that be—?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Pode ser...?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$cdef(27)>, I’m sure you could whip up
something
to
walk
on
to
reach
that
Pokémon, right?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$cdef(27)>, Eu tenho certeza que você poderia chicotear
algo
para
andar
ligado
para
alcance
que
Pokémon, certo?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>Could you go and talk to that Pokémon on our behalf?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>pode ir falar com o Pokémon em nosso nome?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,10)>Could you please go talk to that huge
Pokémon, <$cdef(27)>?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,10)>Por favor, vá falar com aquele enorme
Pokémon, <$cdef(27)>?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,803)><$comeff(4,6)>I wonder what you need to eat to get THAT big...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,803)><$comeff(4,6)>Pergunto-me o que precisas de comer para conseguires aquele grande...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>I feel like it’s about to rain again!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>Eu sinto que está prestes a chover novamente!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(3,8)><$motion(3,803)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,10)>Wow, that’s a really BIG, really LOUD Pokémon!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(3,8)><$motion(3,803)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,10)>Uau, isso é realmente um grande, realmente LOUD Pokémon!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,1)><$facial(4,4)><$comeff(4,10)>That Pokémon’s so cool! <wait(0.5)>And HUGE!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,1)><$facial(4,4)><$comeff(4,10)>Esse Pokémon é tão legal! <wait(0.5)>E grande!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(5,5)><$motion(5,805)><$comeff(5,6)>Well, ain’t you an odd one. You a human? Or a Pokémon?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(5,5)><$motion(5,805)><$comeff(5,6)>Bem, você não é estranho, você é humano ou um Pokémon?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(5,9)><$motion(5,801)><$facial(5,4)><$comeff(5,10)>Gwahaha! Course you are! And you got real guts comin’
this close to me too!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(5,9)><$motion(5,801)><$facial(5,4)><$comeff(5,10)>Gwahaha! Claro que você é! E você tem coragem de verdade chegando’
Tão perto de mim também!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(5,9)><$motion(5,801)><$facial(5,4)><$comeff(5,10)>Gwahaha! Ya got real guts tellin’ me such an obvious lie!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(5,9)><$motion(5,801)><$facial(5,4)><$comeff(5,10)>Gwahaha! Você tem muita coragem de me dizer uma mentira tão óbvia!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(5,6)>Anyway, ya need me fer somethin’?
<$voicel(5,1)><$motion(5,803)>...What’s that, now? Ya say it won’t rain?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(5,6)>De qualquer forma, você precisa de mim para alguma coisa?
<$voicel(5,1)><$motion(5,803)>...O que é isso, agora? Você diz que não vai chover?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(5,4)><$motion(5,805)><$comeff(5,14)>Oh, hmmm...
<$voicel(5,5)>The humans were makin’ a real fuss, y’see. So, I headed
down to the <$voicel(5,4)><$motion(5,807)>quiet ocean floor fer a good, long nap...
<$voicel(5,5)><$emotion(5,14)>But I s’pose that made it stop rainin’ here, huh? <$voicel(5,2)><$motion(5,802)><$facial(5,9)><$comeff(5,7)>Sure am
sorry ’bout that.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(5,4)><$motion(5,805)><$comeff(5,14)>Oh, hmmm...
<$voicel(5,5)>Os humanos estavam fazendo’ um verdadeiro alarido, sim. Então, eu fui
até o <$voicel(5,4)><$motion(5,807)>tranquilo fundo do oceano para uma boa, longa soneca...
<$voicel(5,5)><$emotion(5,14)>Mas suponho que isso fez com que parasse de chover aqui, hein? <$voicel(5,2)><$motion(5,802)><$facial(5,9)><$comeff(5,7)>Claro que sou.
Sinto muito por isso.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(5,3)>Wait a minute...
<$voicel(5,7)><$comeff(5,3)>I only woke up ’cause I felt rain splashin’ on the surface of
the water...
<$voicel(5,6)><$motion(5,803)><$comeff(5,6)>Did y’all do somethin’ to make it rain?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(5,3)>Espera um minuto...
<$voicel(5,7)><$comeff(5,3)>Eu só acordei porque eu senti chuva espirrando’ na superfície de
A água...
<$voicel(5,6)><$motion(5,803)><$comeff(5,6)>Vocês fizeram alguma coisa para fazer chover?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(5,5)><$comeff(5,14)><$motion(5,666)>Hmmm. I see. Didn’t know there were others out there who
could call the rain like me...
<$voicel(5,7)><$comeff(5,10)><$facial(5,4)>Gwahaha! Y’all sure are an interestin’ bunch!
<$voicel(5,9)><$motion(5,801)><$comeff(5,9)>That settles it—startin’ today, y’all can consider me
yer friend!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(5,5)><$comeff(5,14)><$motion(5,666)>Hmmm. Eu vejo. Não sabia que havia outros lá fora que
poderia chamar a chuva como eu...
<$voicel(5,7)><$comeff(5,10)><$facial(5,4)>Gwahaha! Vocês são um grupo de interessados!
<$voicel(5,9)><$motion(5,801)><$comeff(5,9)>Isso resolve isso – começando hoje, vocês podem me considerar
Seu amigo!

dialogues.en:
<$cdef(27)>Kyogre, the Sea Basin Pokémon, has been registered in
your Pokédex...
Your Trainer rank increased to <$cdef(27)><$dtrnrank;0(2)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$cdef(27)>Kyogre, a bacia do mar Pokémon, foi registada em
O teu Pokédex...
O teu posto de treinador aumentou para <$cdef(27)><$dtrnrank;0(2)>!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(5,5)><$motion(5,805)><$facial(5,4)><$comeff(5,3)>All right now! How ’bout I get a li’l rain fallin’ fer my new
friends? Lessee here...
<$motionoff(5,804)><$facial(5,7)><$comeff(5,10)><$se2d(969)><$padvib(3)><$textsize(2)>Gyararoooah!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(5,5)><$motion(5,805)><$facial(5,4)><$comeff(5,3)>Tudo bem agora! Que tal 'eu obter um li'l chuva caindo 'fer meu novo
Amigos, aqui é o Lessee.
<$motionoff(5,804)><$facial(5,7)><$comeff(5,10)><$se2d(969)><$padvib(3)><$textsize(2)>Gyararoooah!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(5,7)><$motion(5,806)>Phew... I think I’m gonna go take another nap. <$voicel(5,10)><$emotion(5,39)>Sure hope
I can see ya again sometime, <$cdef(27)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(5,7)><$motion(5,806)>Acho que vou tirar outra soneca. <$voicel(5,10)><$emotion(5,39)>Espero que sim.
Posso voltar a ver-te, um dia destes. <$cdef(27)>!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>Yaaay! So much rain! It’s pouring!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>Yaaay! Tanta chuva! Está chovendo!

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>All right, <$cdef(27)>. Seeing that rain
cleared
up
any doubt!
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,664)>I’m sure that was the Legendary Pokémon <$cdef(27)>Kyogre—right?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)>Bringing rain to this parched land of ours would be a
simple task for the likes of <$cdef(27)>Kyogre!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Está bem. <$cdef(27)>Ver aquela chuva
limpo
para cima
Qualquer dúvida!
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,664)>Tenho certeza que era o lendário Pokémon <$cdef(27)>Kyogre- Certo?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)>Trazer chuva a esta nossa terra sedenta seria uma
tarefa simples para o tipo de <$cdef(27)>Kyogre!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(3,8)><$emotion(3,39)>Really?! That’s AMAZING!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(3,8)><$emotion(3,39)>Realmente?! Isso é incrível!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)>Wait, hold on... Does that mean my <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance</color> party...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)>Espera, espera... isso significa que o meu... <$cdef(27)>Dança da Chuva</color> festa...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(5,5)><$motion(5,805)><$comeff(5,14)>And my epic yawn...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$voicel(5,5)><$motion(5,805)><$comeff(5,14)>E o meu épico bocejo...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(5)><$voicel(4,3)><$motion(4,807)><$facial(4,9)><$comeff(4,6)>All our hard work...meant nothing?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(5)><$voicel(4,3)><$motion(4,807)><$facial(4,9)><$comeff(4,6)>Todo o nosso trabalho duro... não significou nada?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,6)>Hmmm... <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)>Oh!!!
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)>Yes! Of course! That small amount of rain we got earlier
was what woke <$cdef(27)>Kyogre up!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>All your hard work definitely wasn’t for nothing!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,6)>Hmmm... <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)>Oh!!!
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)>Sim, claro, aquela chuva que tivemos mais cedo.
foi o que acordou <$cdef(27)>Kyogre Levanta-te!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>Todo o seu trabalho duro definitivamente não foi em vão!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,806)><$comeff(4,14)>Think you could bust up that wall there in front of ya and
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,805)><$comeff(4,6)>make a hole big enough for me to get out?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,806)><$comeff(4,14)>Acho que pode rebentar aquela parede à tua frente e...
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,805)><$comeff(4,6)>Fazer um buraco suficientemente grande para eu sair?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,1)>Thank <$cdef(27)>Tangrowth for me, will ya?! I couldn’t have gotten
out without their smarts!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,1)>Obrigado. <$cdef(27)>Tangrowth para mim, você vai?! Eu não poderia ter conseguido
Sem as suas inteligências!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>So, <$cdef(27)>, were you able to
rescue <$cdef(27)>Onix?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>Então... <$cdef(27)>, você conseguiu
Resgate <$cdef(27)>Onix?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Hohoho! That’s good to hear! <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,10)>This is all thanks to you and
the others working so hard together!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Hohoho! É bom ouvir isso! <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,10)>Isto é tudo graças a você e
os outros trabalhando tão duro juntos!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Oh...and the rain just stopped.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>E a chuva parou.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,14)>Thanks to you, Pokémon have been reappearing one
after another.
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,39)>And we’ve even gotten to see the Legendary
Pokémon <$cdef(27)>Kyogre!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,14)>Graças a ti, Pokémon reapareceu.
depois de outro.
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,39)>E até chegamos a ver o lendário
Pokémon <$cdef(27)>Kyogre!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>I believe the rain will continue falling in this town as it
used to, providing the land with moisture.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>Acredito que a chuva continuará a cair nesta cidade.
Antes, fornecia a terra com humidade.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>And looking at you now, I daresay you may be able to
pass through that gate you discovered before.
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>If you go through that gate, I most definitely plan to
accompany you!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>Why, we might meet some more new Pokémon there—or
even humans!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>E olhando para ti agora, atrevo-me a dizer que talvez possas
Passar por aquele portão que já tinhas descoberto.
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Se passares por aquele portão, planeio definitivamente
Acompanhar-te!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>Ora, talvez nos encontremos com mais algum Pokémon novo lá - ou
Até mesmo humanos!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Hey, heyyy! Looks like we’re gettin’ some crazy rain here
now! <$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,805)><$comeff(4,6)>That your handiwork, <$cdef(27)>?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Hey, heyyy! Parece que estamos recebendo alguma chuva louca aqui
Agora! <$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,805)><$comeff(4,6)>Que o seu trabalho, <$cdef(27)>?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>Heck yeah! Thanks! I can tell the walls and floor of the
cave are way softer now!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>Obrigado! Eu posso dizer as paredes eo chão do
As cavernas estão mais suaves agora!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,1)><$motion(4,802)><$facial(4,9)><$comeff(4,7)>But, uh...I hate to admit it, but I’ve been stuck here so
long that I’ve got barely any strength left to break out!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,1)><$motion(4,802)><$facial(4,9)><$comeff(4,7)>Mas, uh... eu odeio admitir isso, mas eu tenho sido preso aqui para
por muito tempo que eu tenho quase nenhuma força para irromper!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$facial(4,4)><$comeff(4,10)>Ohhh yeah! Now I can finally get outta here!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$facial(4,4)><$comeff(4,10)>Agora posso finalmente sair daqui!

dialogues.en:
<$motion(4,803)><$facial(4,4)><$comeff(4,21)><$voicel(4,7)><$cdef(27)>! It’s all thanks to you, bud! I’ll
never
forget
what
you’ve
done
for
me here!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(4,803)><$facial(4,4)><$comeff(4,21)><$voicel(4,7)><$cdef(27)>! É tudo graças a você, amigo! Eu vou
nunca
esquecer
o que
você tem
feito
